title: AI-Driven Drowsiness Detection: Enhancing Road Safety through Inclusive and Real-Time Monitoring
summary: Catalink is validating a driver-monitoring prototype. Fewer crashes and safer public transport remain intended outcomes.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Catalink is validating a driver-monitoring prototype. Fewer crashes and safer public transport remain intended outcomes.
purpose: Detect driver fatigue across diverse users and driving conditions.

ratings.reason: Drivers and passengers are intended to be safer; no prevented crash or observed intervention is reported.
Transport operators are intended to monitor fatigue more reliably; no operational improvement is measured.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-Driven Drowsiness Detection: Enhancing Road Safety through Inclusive and Real-Time Monitoring

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: A more inclusive AI drowsiness detector
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
